lines.text: Jesus went from there to His hometown, accompanied by His disciples.
On the Sabbath He taught in the synagogue, and many who heard Him were astonished.
The people called Jesus the shepherd, the brother of James, Joses, Judas, and Simon, and they took offense.
Jesus said a prophet is without honor in his hometown, so He healed only a few sick people.
Jesus was amazed at their faith, and He went around from village to village, teaching the people.
